title: Ngā Pono o Makkah
intro: I ngā rā tōmua o te whakakitenga, i te wā i tūtaki ai te karere o te pono ki te whakahē nui, i tū pakari ētahi wairua i roto i ō rātou whakapono. I tūtaki ēnei whakapono ki te tukino e kore e taea te whakaaro mai i te hunga i whai ki te tineia te māramatanga o te whakapono. He nui te mamae, he nui te mamae—engari kāore ō rātou arero i mutu ki te kauwhau i te Kotahitanga o Allah. Ahakoa i maka ki roto i te hohonutanga o te ngakaukore, i karapotia rātou e te tiakitanga atua, e huri ana i ō rātou whakamātautau hei kawenata whakapono mutunga kore. Kia tūhuratia te haerenga o ēnei wairua whakamiharo.
clues: I whakamatautauria mātou ki te whiu nui mō te kore e whakarērea tō mātou whakapono ki te Atua Kotahi
Kāore i taea e tō mātou iwi te wawahi i tō mātou whakatau, ahakoa te auaha o tō rātou nanakia
I whakairihia mātou i te puna i te awatea, heoi i tata tonu te āwhina a te Atua
I miharo te hunga i kite i tō mātou manawanui ki tō mātou manawanui
He tokomaha i Makkah i ngana ki te akiaki i a mātou kia whakarērea, engari i mau tonu tō mātou kaha.
I te wā i ngaro katoa ai te āhua, i tae mai tō tātou herekoretanga mā te wawaotanga whakamiharo a te Atua
